component.name: Media Player Pro
component.summary: Modern media player with transparent glass controls, red theme, and video enhancement

description.p: Media Player Pro is an advanced, high-performance media player built on top of mpv. It features a non-obstructive 100% transparent bottom bar with floating red controls, playback memory remembering the last 20 unfinished videos with an interactive resume prompt, interactive cursor-targeted zoom and dragging, speed dropup selector, and a 3-level genuine video enhancement engine powered by AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) and deband filtering.

ul.li: Integrated native open/pick file dialog across all major Linux desktops (Wayland and X11)
Intelligent desktop detection: native kdialog on KDE Plasma, native zenity and XDG Desktop Portal on GNOME, Cinnamon, MATE, XFCE, and Wayland compositors
Comprehensive media file filters and contextual start directory navigation
Robust error-handling and fallback cascade ensuring reliable file picking across all distros
Matched remaining play time text color, font weight, and styling with played elapsed time
Streamlined playback dock layout: removed fullscreen icon button in favor of video double-click and keyboard toggling
Optimized volume slider position and control alignment
Added double-click to toggle fullscreen strictly in the video area above the seekbar
Double-click fullscreen is suppressed on the seekbar, dock controls, and popover menus to avoid accidental triggers during rapid seeking
Added direct GitHub update download button under Settings menu
Enhanced dynamic resize and fullscreen geometry tracking
Added dedicated Fullscreen toggle button on the dock to the left of Settings
Disabled accidental double-click fullscreen toggle on rapid button/seek presses
Updated media skip navigation from 7 seconds to 5 seconds across controls and shortcuts
Redesigned content-focused high-contrast settings menu with crystal-clear pure white typography and high-visibility status badge pills
Solid deep obsidian popup backing preventing background video bleed-through and ensuring perfect legibility
Fixed Video Enhancement toggle: resolved inter-script communication and robust shader path resolution
Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+1 (Flip Video Horizontally) and Ctrl+2 (Rotate Video 90° Clockwise)
Enhanced touch hitboxes across settings and aspect ratio submenus

TrueTheater-style GPU Video Enhancement Engine: Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS), Adaptive Local Tone Mapping lighting, and skin-tone protected chroma vibrance in a unified real-time GLSL master shader
Interactive Hover Tooltips: Frosted glass tooltips for all dock controls on hover
Aspect Ratio Submenu: Interactive selector with active ratio display (Auto, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 16:10, 1:1)
Settings Toggle: Single 1-click ON/OFF toggle for TrueTheater video enhancement, persistent across restarts
A/B Comparison Diagnostic Mode: 50% split-screen before/after shader view toggleable via Ctrl+Shift+E
Streamlined Dock: Cleaned up window controls from dock bar for distraction-free media experience
Smart Resume Memory: Remembers last 20 unfinished videos and prompts to resume or start over
Red-based theme with glowing red seekbar line and scrubber thumb
100% transparent bottom bar removing background occlusion so video is completely unobstructed
Clean media skip backward (◄◄) and forward (►►) icons (removing '7s' text)
New frosted glass surround app icon with vibrant red play button
Full dual Wayland and X11 compositor compatibility with fallback context probing

description.p: Media Player Pro v1.1 Initial Release
